22176-the-winged-men-of-orcon-a-complete.title: The Winged Men Of Orcon A Complete Novelette
22176-the-winged-men-of-orcon-a-complete.creator: Unknown
22176-the-winged-men-of-orcon-a-complete.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. What I saw first, hanging on a hook on one wall, was a bunch of keys, one of which readily opened the lock of my handcuffs. Then there was a long-barrelled, gleaming atomic gun, undamaged, and a couple of the new cold-ray flashlights. Free, I caught up one of the flashlights, and placed back on their hook the keys which had opened the cuffs.

67624-unfinished-rainbows-and-other-essa.title: And Other Essays
67624-unfinished-rainbows-and-other-essa.creator: George Wood Anderson
67624-unfinished-rainbows-and-other-essa.description: A book by George Wood Anderson. Looking from the narrow window of the wave-tossed ark, upon the silent grandeur of a world slowly arising from the waters of an universal flood, Noah beheld the rainbow and rejoiced in the blest assurance, that, while the things of man are subject to the ravages of time and destruction of contending elements, the things of God are always stable and secure.

arxiv-1710-09489.title: Scalable Neural Network Decoders for Higher Dimensional Quantum Codes
arxiv-1710-09489.creator: N. P. Breuckmann, X. Ni
arxiv-1710-09489.description: Abstract Machine learning has the potential to become an important tool in quantum error correction as it allows the decoder to adapt to the error distribution of a quantum chip. An additional motivation for using neural networks is the fact that they can be evaluated by dedicated hardware which is very fast and consumes little power.

arxiv-1906-05150.title: Exploring Bayesian approaches to eQTL mapping through probabilistic programming
arxiv-1906-05150.creator: Dimitrios V. Vavoulis
arxiv-1906-05150.description: Abstract The discovery of genomic polymorphisms influencing gene expression (also known as expression quantitative trait loci or eQTLs ) can be formulated as a sparse Bayesian multivariate/multiple regression problem. An important aspect in the development of such models is the implementation of bespoke inference methodologies, a process which can become quite laborious, when multiple candidate models are being considered.

arxiv-2104-05254.title: Numerical study of a 20W class QCW pulsed sodium guide star laser’s performances at five sites in China
arxiv-2104-05254.creator: Hong-Yang Li, Lu Feng, Jun-Wei Zuo, Qi Bian, Bo-Tian Sun, Sui-Jian Xue, Zhi-Xia Shen, Yang-Peng Li, Yong Bo
arxiv-2104-05254.description: Abstract In the past few years, Chinese astronomical community is actively testing astronomical sites for several new optical/infrared ground-based telescopes. These site testing campaigns conducted were mainly focused on fundamental performances of the site, such as cloud coverage, seeing, temperature, etc.

arxiv-2207-01294.title: A New Index for Clustering Evaluation Based on Density Estimation DOI: 00.000/000_0 ISBN: 000-0000-00-000/00/00 Conference: 000; 0000; Beijing, China Price: 00.00
arxiv-2207-01294.creator: Gangli Liu
arxiv-2207-01294.description: Abstract . A new index for internal evaluation of clustering is introduced. The index is defined as a mixture of two sub-indices. The first sub-index I a I_{a} is called the Ambiguous Index; the second sub-index I s I_{s} is called the Similarity Index.

arxiv-2305-14237.title: Hop, Union, Generate : Explainable Multi-hop Reasoning without Rationale Supervision
arxiv-2305-14237.creator: Wenting Zhao, Justin T. Chiu, Claire Cardie, Alexander M. Rush
arxiv-2305-14237.description: Abstract Explainable multi-hop question answering (QA) not only predicts answers but also identifies rationales, i. e. subsets of input sentences used to derive the answers. This problem has been extensively studied under the supervised setting, where both answer and rationale annotations are given.

arxiv-2405-20512.title: How Multilingual Are Large Language Models Fine-Tuned for Translation?
arxiv-2405-20512.creator: Aquia Richburg, Marine Carpuat
arxiv-2405-20512.description: Abstract A new paradigm for machine translation has recently emerged: fine-tuning large language models ( Llm ) on parallel text has been shown to outperform dedicated translation systems trained in a supervised fashion on much larger amounts of parallel data ( Xu et al. 2024a ; Alves et al. 2024 ) .

arxiv-2504-14245.title: Towards Explainable Fake Image Detection with Multi-Modal Large Language Models DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation email; Oct 27, 2025; Dublin, Ireland ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06
arxiv-2504-14245.creator: Yikun Ji, Jiahui Zhan, Yan Hong, Haoxing Chen, Jun Lan, Huijia Zhu, Weiqiang Wang, Liqing Zhang, Jianfu Zhang
arxiv-2504-14245.description: Abstract . Recent advancements in image generation have provoked social and security concerns, yet most detection methods rely on black-box models that generalize poorly. By utilizing advances in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs), we propose a framework that fuses six specialized paradigms, each analyzing a distinct aspect of the image, to provide a final verdict with coherent, evidence-based reasoning.

arxiv-2506-21908.title: Spin non-Collinear Real-Time Time-Dependent Density-Functional Theory and Implementation in the Modern GPU-Accelerated INQ code
arxiv-2506-21908.creator: Jacopo Simoni, Xavier Andrade, Wuzhang Fang, Andrew C. Grieder, Alfredo A. Correa, Tadashi Ogitsu, Yuan Ping
arxiv-2506-21908.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jacopo Simoni, Xavier Andrade, Wuzhang Fang, Andrew C. Grieder, Alfredo A. Correa, Tadashi Ogitsu, Yuan Ping. Time-dependent density functional theory is a theory that describes the time evolution of quantum mechanical many-electron systems under the influence of external time-dependent electric and magnetic fields. INQ is a specially designed software to efficiently solve the real-time time-dependent density functional theory equations on graphics processing units, which aim to overcome the computational limitation of time and size scales of non-equilibrium quantum dynamics.

arxiv-2510-23947.title: Toward Socially-Aware LLMs: A Survey of Multimodal Approaches to Human Behavior Understanding
arxiv-2510-23947.creator: Zihan Liu, Parisa Rabbani, Veda Duddu, Kyle Fan, Madison Lee, Yun Huang
arxiv-2510-23947.description: Abstract . LLM-powered multimodal systems are increasingly used to interpret human social behavior, yet how researchers apply the models’ "social competence" remains poorly understood. This paper presents a systematic literature review of 176 publications across different application domains (e.g., healthcare, education, and entertainment).

arxiv-2512-22090.title: Abstraction of Trusted Execution Environments as the Missing Layer for Broad Confidential Computing Adoption: A Systematization of Knowledge
arxiv-2512-22090.creator: Quentin Michaud, Sara Ramezanian, Dhouha Ayed, Olivier Levillain, Joaquin Garcia-Alfaro
arxiv-2512-22090.description: Abstract . Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) protect sensitive code and data from the operating system, hypervisor, or other untrusted software. Different solutions exist, each proposing different features. Abstraction layers aim to unify the ecosystem, allowing application developers and system administrators to leverage confidential computing as broadly and efficiently as possible. We start with an overview of representative available TEE technologies.

pmc-10660524.title: An Open-Label Case Series of Glutathione Use for Symptomatic Management in Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder
pmc-10660524.creator: Karam Radwan, Gary Wu, Kamilah Banks-Word, Ryan Rosenberger
pmc-10660524.description: Simple SummaryAutism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder that can cause impaired social–emotional interactions, impaired language and communication skills, repetitive or restrictive behaviors, and sometimes aggressive behavior. An emerging topic in research is the imbalance between bodily oxidative systems and anti-oxidative stress in autism spectrum cases.

pmc-11411237.title: Understanding hospital antimicrobial prescribing decisions and determinants of uptake of new local antimicrobial prescribing guidelines in Laos
pmc-11411237.creator: Vilada Chansamouth, Anousone Douangnouvong, Peeyanout Thammavongsa, Xaysana Sombandith, Sommay Keomany, Sommana Rattana, Paul N Newton, Nicholas PJ Day, Paul Turner, Mayfong Mayxay, H. Rogier van Doorn, Elizabeth A Ashley, Minyahil Tadesse Boltena, Trisha Peel, Soe Yu Naing, Priyadharsini RP, Vilada
pmc-11411237.description: BackgroundAntimicrobial use in Laos is among the highest in Southeast Asia. The first Lao comprehensive antimicrobial prescribing guidelines have been available since 2021. This study explored the determinants of antibiotic prescribing decisions and how the new prescribing guidelines were being used. MethodsIn August 2022, in-depth interviews were conducted with 16 Lao prescribers from two hospitals.

pmc-11480271.title: Development trends and knowledge framework of artificial intelligence (AI) applications in oncology by years: a bibliometric analysis from 1992 to 2022
pmc-11480271.creator: Murat Koçak, Zafer Akçalı
pmc-11480271.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeOncology is the primary field in medicine with a high rate of artificial intelligence (AI) use. Thus, this study aimed to investigate the trends of AI in oncology, evaluating the bibliographic characteristics of articles.

pmc-11500728.title: Melanin in the Retinal Epithelium and Magnetic Sensing: A Review of Current Studies
pmc-11500728.creator: Lidia Zueva, Vassiliy Tsytsarev, Janaina Alves, Mikhail Inyushin
pmc-11500728.description: Coming in a variety of forms, melanin is one of the most abundant, stable, diverse, and evolutionarily ancient pigments found in living things in nature. These pigments often serve protective functions, typically well-adapted to their specific roles. One such protective function is metal chelation and cation exchange, which help regulate and buffer metal concentrations within cells.

pmc-12549175.title: Cannabis and Nicotine Substance Use Coercion During the Perinatal Period
pmc-12549175.creator: Peyton Groves, Callie Laubacher, Yesmina Salib, Erin Mickievicz, Virginia Duplessis, Nicole Molinaro, Dara D Méndez, Katherine Guyon-Harris, Ruben G Martinez, Judy Chang, Natacha M De Genna, Maya I Ragavan
pmc-12549175.description: Introduction:Perinatal intimate partner violence (IPV) and perinatal cannabis and nicotine product use are common and associated with negative maternal–infant health outcomes. Substance use coercion (SUC), which involves abusive partners’ controlling behaviors related to substance use, has not been studied for cannabis and nicotine products.

pmc-12559181.title: Research and engineering practice on mechanical reaming for pressure relief and rock burst prevention technology in hard coal seam roadways
pmc-12559181.creator: Jia-hao Xie, Zi-wei Ding, Guang-an Zhu, Xiao-qi Hao, Jin-dui Jia
pmc-12559181.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Coal seam drilling for pressure relief is one of the most widely adopted measures to mitigate rock bursts. However, conventional drilling methods exhibit limited effectiveness in hard coal seams and may compromise the integrity of roadway support structures. To optimize traditional pressure relief drilling parameters, this study investigated the influence of coal seam strength and borehole diameter on pressure relief efficiency based on elastoplastic mechanics theory.

pmc-13397089.creator: Parsa Ahsan, Mahnoor Fatima, Beenish Malik, Asghar Awan

pmc-13569459.title: AI-informed healthcare pedagogy: a review of the literature and application to pedagogical practice informed by case studies from dental education
pmc-13569459.creator: Nilufar Ahmed
pmc-13569459.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) applications in healthcare continue to grow at a rapid pace. Healthcare education is struggling to effectively integrate the manifold applications and opportunities presented by AI to education. Concerns and fears around negative impacts on student learning and potential for misuse alongside a paucity of guidance has led to a sluggish response across much of healthcare education.
